| UM-T43 | 2026-10-21 | fix | closed | ProcessSshCommandRunner.BuildArgs never uses SshTarget.Passphrase: GenericVpsProvisioner.ResolveTarget and HostingComposer.BuildConnection both read a 'sshPassphrase' ProviderSecret into SshTarget, implying passphrase-protected private keys are supported, but the actual ssh invocation only passes -p/-i/BatchMode=yes/StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new -- BatchMode=yes disables every interactive prompt including the passphrase one, and nothing else (no SSH_ASKPASS, no ssh-agent) feeds it in, so every real SSH call (deploy/status/logs/update/destroy) against a passphrase-protected key fails authentication silently. NOT fixed in this pass: the correct remediation (SSH_ASKPASS_REQUIRE=force + a generated askpass helper, vs spawning/reusing an ssh-agent, vs simply documenting that mp-host requires a passphrase-free key and dropping the sshPassphrase credential) is a product decision with real cross-platform (the CLI runs on the operator's own OS, Windows or Linux, shelling to system ssh) and security (temporary credential material handling) tradeoffs that cannot be verified in this sandbox (no real sshd, no passphrase-protected key, no way to exercise it end to end).
